title: Sony’s 1000XM4C headphones are a Black Friday bargain at $198
summary: All three colors (including the stunning lavender) are down to their lowest price yet just a few months after launch. Sony’s WH-1000XM5 are available during Black Friday at Best Buy for $169, their lowest price yet from a major retailer.
